facts.text: The resort is on the east end of St. Thomas, with views of Great Bay and access to the neighboring islands of St. John and the British Virgin Islands.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the island's idyllic east end, our resort offers breathtaking views of Great Bay and seamless access to the neighboring islands of St. John and the British Virgin Islands.

facts.text: St. John is a short three miles across Pillsbury Sound, and the British Virgin Islands are a short boat ride away.
facts.excerpt: St. John is a short three miles across Pillsbury Sound and the British Virgin Islands are just a short boat ride away.

facts.text: The resort is a 30-acre oceanfront property.
facts.excerpt: A breathtaking 30-acre, oceanfront luxury resort

facts.text: The resort has its own sailing catamaran, the Lady Lynsey II, used for sunset sails, day sails to the British Virgin Islands, snorkeling tours and private events.
facts.excerpt: Set sail aboard The Ritz-Carlton’s exclusive luxury sailing catamaran, The Lady Lynsey II. Embark on a sunset sail through the bay, a day sail to the British Virgin Islands, snorkeling tours and private events.

facts.text: The resort has a free-form infinity edge pool and a Family Pool with a waterslide.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our 125-foot free-form infinity edge pool or make a splash at the Family Pool and waterslide, perfect for all ages.

facts.text: Resort guests can rent a private pool cabana for the day, with a personal attendant for food and beverage requests.
facts.excerpt: Resort guests can relax in their private pool cabana, available for a full-day rental from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. A personal attendant will assist with any food and beverage requests during your pool day.

facts.text: Alloro Restaurant serves a Sicilian-inspired menu with fresh pasta, seafood and hearty mains.
facts.excerpt: Savor the flavors of Sicily with a menu inspired by its rich culinary traditions. Enjoy fresh pasta, vibrant seafood and hearty mains

facts.text: Sails Beachside Restaurant & Bar is an oceanfront restaurant by day and becomes an open-air bar at night, serving grilled steaks and seafood.
facts.excerpt: By day, Sails is an oceanfront retreat in St. Thomas where relaxed elegance meets the rhythm of island life. As night falls, it transforms into an open-air bar, offering grilled steaks and signature seafood dishes in a coastal setting.

facts.text: Coconut Cove Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant with an American twist, serving bites by day and grilled dishes at night.
facts.excerpt: This is a relaxed beachfront retreat with an American twist, serving up zesty bites by day and grilled favorites with coastal flair by night.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers four food and beverage presentations each day: breakfast, a light lunch, heavy hors d'oeuvres at dinner and a dessert buffet at night.
facts.excerpt: The Club lounge provides four food and beverage offerings each day including breakfast, light lunch, heavy hors d’oeuvres at dinner, and a dessert buffet at night.

facts.text: Club Level stays include access to a private Club beach.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the tranquility of our private Club beach offering unparalleled relaxation and stunning views.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: The Three-Bedroom Presidential Suite has five full bathrooms, private ocean-view terraces, and living and dining areas.
facts.excerpt: Experience ultimate relaxation in our expansive Three-Bedroom Presidential Suite, featuring five full bathrooms, private ocean-view terraces, and spacious living and dining areas.

facts.text: The spa offers a Seaside Cabana Massage at the water's edge that can be shared as a couples massage.
facts.excerpt: Experience a full body massage while you indulge in the tranquility of the waves and gentle breezes allowing you to relax and unwind at the water’s edge. Can also be shared with someone special as a couples massage.

facts.text: The resort has two lighted omni-synthetic tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Thomas is proud to offer two omni-synthetic tennis courts, lighted for nighttime playing.

facts.text: The resort runs a Ritz Kids program for children.
facts.excerpt: Take part in the newly evolved Ritz Kids program, an engaging and immersive experience dedicated to our little ladies and gentlemen.

facts.text: The watersports team assists guests with Hobie Cats, kayaks, snorkel equipment and stand-up paddleboards.
facts.excerpt: Our Watersports team is dedicated to assisting guests with Hobie Cats, kayaks, snorkel equipment, and stand-up paddleboards.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: A daily resort fee applies, covering fitness classes, non-motorized watersports, snorkel gear, Wi-Fi and tennis court use.
facts.excerpt: Our daily resort fee of $95 grants access to a thoughtfully curated collection of amenities, including daily fitness classes, a welcome drink and beverage station, introductory and daily use of non-motorized watersports

facts.text: Great Bay Beach holds Blue Flag Certification.
facts.excerpt: Great Bay Beach holds the Blue Flag Certification

facts.text: The property was remodeled and reopened in 2019, with rooms and suites in neutral colors and delicate fabrics.
facts.excerpt: After a remodel and reopening in 2019, the Ritz-Carlton’s St. Thomas property still focuses on understated elegance.
